label: Origin-determined access with a varied individual gives the tolerance rival
description: Conditional bridge from the origin interface to the structural frame condition: reflexive and symmetric closeness plus access exactly when shared individuals have near origins gives reflexive and symmetric access. The same individual with non-near origins at two successors of w prevents access between those successors. The three listed premises therefore entail ToleranceNonEuclideanAt at w; OriginPlenitude is not needed. No converse or general representation theorem is claimed: the old surrogate having no origin interface does not by itself prove that no such interface can be supplied.
